rationale.edition: Changed paths span both OSS and enterprise ownership: OSS backend (src/api/search/src/search/query_manager.rs, src/search_service/src/*, src/api/grpc/...), OSS frontend (web/src/components/queries/*, web/src/services/*.ts), and enterprise code (o2_enterprise/src/enterprise/search/query_manager.rs, o2_enterprise/src/enterprise/super_cluster/search/mod.rs) plus o2_openfga/src/meta/route_permissions.rs RBAC wiring. The combined diff is a linked OSS+ENT sister pair, so edition is 'both'.
rationale.skip: Not skipped. The change alters a user-facing flow (the Running Queries management page and its cancel action), and there is no explicit opt-out: feature_hint.txt and trigger_comment.txt are both empty and no tests-added label or skip comment was passed.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted. The cancel contract changed from a bare trace-id list to org-scoped [{trace_id, org_id}] pairs, the single-query DELETE route was removed, and query status is now restricted to _meta. The frontend (RunningQueries.vue, RunningQueriesList.vue, SummaryList.vue, search.ts, streaming_search.ts) was reworked to group by org and send the new payload, so the cancel single/bulk/summary UI flow needs verifying.
rationale.area: The bulk of the UI change lives in web/src/components/queries/ (RunningQueries, RunningQueriesList, SummaryList), which is the Running Queries management page. There is no dedicated 'Queries' playwright area in the existing matrix, and this page is a general/_meta admin surface not specific to Logs/Metrics/Traces, so GeneralTests is the closest fit.
rationale.group: GeneralTests is the closest existing shard (actual_folder GeneralTests, currently holding sanity.spec.js); no query-management shard exists, so the spec should join GeneralTests or the Engineer may create a dedicated group.
rationale.existing_tests: No Playwright E2E specs in the diff. The only changed tests are Vitest unit specs under web/src/**/*.spec.ts (RunningQueries.spec.ts, RunningQueriesList.spec.ts, SummaryList.spec.ts, search.spec.ts, streaming_search.spec.ts) and pytest API tests under tests/api-testing/ — none are E2E coverage under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/.
